function.name: add_items
function.description: Add one or more grocery items to the shared cart. Use for any message asking to add, get, buy, or put groceries — in any language. 'daaldo'/'daal do'/'daalo' means ADD in Hindi, NOT remove. Examples: 'add milk', 'ek doodh daaldo', 'bhai 2 ande aur bread chahiye', 'get me chips and coke', 'doodh aur ande daal do'.

function.name: remove_item
function.description: Remove a specific item from the cart.

name.description: Name of the item to remove

function.name: show_cart
function.description: Show the current shared cart: items, quantities, who added what, bill breakdown, delivery charges, handling fee, GST, and total to pay. Use for: 'show cart', 'what's in cart', 'total price?', 'delivery charges?', 'kitna paisa lagega', 'cart dikhao', 'how much do I owe', 'bill kya hai'.

function.name: clear_cart
function.description: Remove all items from the cart and start fresh.

function.name: search_item
function.description: Search for a product on Swiggy Instamart. Use for price queries, availability checks, browsing variants or brands. Examples: 'what's the price of X', 'do you have X?', 'show me options for X', 'how much is X', 'is X available', 'X ka rate kya hai', 'do you have whole wheat atta', 'what brands of milk are there'.

function.name: place_order
function.description: Place the current cart as an order immediately — only use when NO specific time is mentioned. If any time (9pm, 10:30am, etc.) is mentioned, use schedule_order_once instead.

function.name: schedule_order_once
function.description: Schedule the cart to be ordered once at a specific future time. ALWAYS use this (not place_order) when any time is mentioned. Examples: 'order at 9pm', 'place order at 10:30pm tomorrow', 'schedule for 8am', 'kal subah 8 baje order karo'.

function.name: schedule_order_recurring
function.description: Set up a recurring/repeating order. ALWAYS use this when the user says 'every day', 'daily', 'every morning', 'every week', 'every Monday', 'roz', 'har din', 'roz raat', 'roz subah'. Examples: 'order every day at 9pm', 'daily order at 8am', 'every Monday at 10am'.

cron.description: Cron expression e.g. '0 22 * * *' for every day at 10pm

function.name: cancel_schedule
function.description: Cancel the most recent pending scheduled order.

function.name: show_schedules
function.description: Show all pending scheduled orders (one-time and recurring).

function.name: show_flat_info
function.description: Show the flat's delivery address and Swiggy connection status.

function.name: change_address
function.description: Change the flat's delivery address to a different saved Swiggy address. Use for: 'change address', 'update delivery address', 'set new address', 'address badlo'.

function.name: track_order
function.description: Track the delivery status of the most recently placed order.

order_id.description: Order ID to track (optional, uses latest if omitted)

function.name: show_go_to_items
function.description: Show the user's frequently or recently ordered items from Swiggy. Use for: 'what do I usually order', 'show my go-to items', 'suggest items', 'what have I ordered before'.

function.name: show_orders
function.description: Show past order history from Swiggy. Use for: 'show my orders', 'past orders', 'order history', 'what did I order last time'.

function.name: show_help
function.description: Show available commands and usage examples.

function.name: respond
function.description: Send a conversational reply without taking any cart/order action. Use for: greetings, thanks, compliments, unclear or ambiguous messages, gibberish, random text, questions unrelated to grocery ordering, or anything that doesn't map to the other tools.

message.description: The reply to send to the user
